# FLINT-SYNC/1 reference

<!-- Generated by python3 tools/docs.py; edit flint-sync.schema.json. -->

Messages are newline-delimited JSON over TCP or stdio, not HTTP.
The [JSON Schema](flint-sync.schema.json) describes wire objects.
The [implementation spec](flint-server-spec.md) remains normative for
canonical bytes, signatures, crash recovery, and authentication.

## Requests

`seq` is an unsigned 32-bit client correlator, echoed in replies.
Omitting it currently defaults to zero; clients should always send it.

| Operation | Required fields | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hello` | `op`, `proto` | Negotiate the protocol; returns a nonce when authentication is enabled. |
| `auth` | `op`, `nonce`, `hmac` | Authenticate after hello using the returned nonce and the domain-separated HMAC. |
| `list` | `op` | List stream records. This read-only operation is also used by the health probe. |
| `heads` | `op` | Return a canonical stream-ID to head map. |
| `open` | `op` | Look up a stream by UUID or name using stream. The existing name alias is accepted only when stream is absent; stream takes precedence. |
| `read` | `op`, `stream` | Read raw signed Change lines after a cursor. Limits above 1024 are clamped. |
| `create` | `op`, `record` | Create a stream record; non-null heads must refer to a valid fork point. |
| `append` | `op`, `stream`, `changes` | Append a nonempty, fully verified batch. Change strings are raw JSONL bytes without the final newline. |

## Responses

Every reply includes `seq` and `ok`. Refusals additionally include
`refuse` and `detail`. Success payloads depend on the operation.

Refusal vocabulary: `stream_missing`, `stream_exists`, `stale_head`, `change_malformed`, `change_missing`, `sig_invalid`, `store_too_large`, `stream_malformed`, `stream_torn`, `message_invalid`, `usage`, `proto_version`, `auth_required`, `auth_failed`, `author_not_allowed`, `store_not_found`, `store_missing`.

One session has one request in flight. Lines are bounded to 4 MiB.
There are at most 4096 changes per stream. `read` defaults to 256
changes and caps a requested limit at 1024.

## Authentication

When configured, `hello` returns a random 16-byte nonce as lowercase hex.
`auth` supplies the same nonce and HMAC-SHA256 over the bytes
`"FLINT-SYNC-AUTH/1\x00" || nonce`, using the external 32-byte key.
Authentication failure closes the session. Use an encrypted tunnel
for confidentiality; this protocol does not implement TLS.
